long-jump.provenance: p1_v1 stored iteration 15250. Original launch_p1.sh and recorded agent/env YAML recovered. Entropy 0.005; no evaluation gap/drop pin. Uses the published platform-jump source, which contains later research changes, not the original p1 implementation.
long-jump.limitations: Supported continuation from original PPO state under explicit current-source settings, not bit-exact p1 replay. Stage schedule is applied at the restored counter; new episode/RNG state. No external reset bank required.

backflip.provenance: f21_liftoff stored iteration 12000. launch_f21.sh and recorded agent/env YAML recovered. Restores 0.7-0.9 m drop range, entropy 0.003, initial midflip probability 0.25, takeoff weight 45, minimum takeoff vz 0 and curriculum shift 3000. Current published source is pinned separately; not a complete historical source reconstruction.
backflip.limitations: Restored counter selects the mature midflip curriculum (probability 0.15), not the initial 0.25 mix. Fresh simulator/RNG. No external reset bank required. Landing may break the real robot; no hardware or successful-flight claim follows from the smoke test.
